mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_access_logs ( id, actor_id, actor_role, action, endpoint, target_user_ids, result_count, status_code, ip_address, user_agent, request_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole}, #{action}, #{endpoint}, CAST(#{targetUserIds, jdbcType=ARRAY, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler} AS uuid[]), #{resultCount}, #{statusCode}, CAST(#{ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS inet), #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.actor_id, u.name AS actor_name, l.actor_role, l.action, l.endpoint, array_to_string(l.target_user_ids, ',') AS target_user_ids_csv, l.result_count, l.status_code, host(l.ip_address) AS ip_address, l.user_agent, l.request_id, l.created_at FROM tb_admin_access_logs l LEFT JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = l.actor_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
